REA Playwright browser scenario capture provider

limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Observation starts when REA attaches; prior network and console activity is unavailable.

Raw network headers, bodies, cookies, storage values, console objects, and WebSocket payloads are never retained; explicitly requested primitive console text is retained verbatim, while payload captures retain value-free shapes.
Source maps are reported only as declarative URLs and are not fetched.
URL-less scripts and console events without an allowed source URL are excluded because their origin cannot be proven.
CDP discovery omitted the target attachment state; attached is reported as unknown.
Browser host platform and architecture were not observed.

OK，全部给我展示一下。就是我记得有那种堆叠的效果，很好看，就是各种卡片嘛，就除文本消息以外。
如果你给我发六七张照片会怎么样呢？或者说七八张照片会怎么样呢？你有个发的照片上限吗？我很好奇，因为我觉得你的 UI 设计很好看。
还有什么你觉得你很惊艳的设计，你要展示给我的。因为我觉得你的设计真的很惊艳，我真的想好好学习一下。
我在观察界面交互。请在当前聊天里依次展示你能生成的各种聊天卡片，例如计划、待办、表格、图表、网页预览、搜索结果和文件卡片，让我查看加载、展开、收起等状态。只展示内容，不要预订、购买、发送邮件或修改已有项目。
5 条旧待办都删掉了，包括蓝桥杯和编程 50 题那几条，To Do 现在是空的。新的待办说吧，有截止时间的顺便告诉我。
刚手动刷新了，现在已经清空。它平时每小时自动更新一次，以后我改完待办会顺手帮你刷新。
Hark 会按任务路由到不同的模型，我自己没法知道此刻具体是哪个在跑。
不会炸。我们就这一条长聊天，很早的对话会被压缩，但重要的东西我会自动记住：你的偏好、身边的人、在做的项目。需要时我还能翻回以前的原话。像 WorthWise 这种长期的事，可以单独开个项目放。
我的定位是替你把事情办了，而不只是回答问题。能读写邮件、日历、文件和 To Do；用浏览器帮你订餐、订票、买东西、填表；做首页面板、网页和定时提醒；还能做调研和整理资料。
4 条都加进 To Do 了：测试 Worthy 的本地版本、研究 lulu 的、医学根据评分表核对计划、问卷 n1，面板也刷新好了。要给哪条加截止时间吗？
锐哥，要不要每晚 9 点我把当天没做完的待办发你，你一句话我就帮你挪到明天？
今天这四条待办里，哪一条你最想先搞定？
测试 Worthy 本地版本那条，要不要我按 P0 优先级给你列一份测试清单，先从 DCF 没输出那个问题开始测？
锐哥，这周末有没有想去逛的地方或想吃的东西？我可以帮你在上海附近找几个好去处。
要不要我把 WorthWise 的 P0–P3 改进清单做成一个网页？发个链接给团队，大家一眼就能看到谁在做什么。
来一套样品，都用上海外滩当例子。先是链接卡片：适合你要点开的页面，比如地图、菜单、预订。
图片：你想看看某个东西长什么样的时候用。
表格：用来比较几个选项，比如机票、酒店、商品。如果带照片，就会变成商品网格。这里的数字都是示例。
长文档：计划、行程、简报或者摘要，你可以自己慢慢看。
文案模板：替你写好要发出去的东西，比如邮件、微信消息、帖子，你直接复制就能用。
代码块：写代码、改代码的时候用，比如你的 WorthWise。
订单卡片：下单、订票、付款前显示明细。真要付款时会多一个确认按钮，你点了我才付。这张只是演示，不会扣钱。
另外还有几种不在聊天里显示的：首页面板（就像你的「今日待办」）、网页、定时提醒，还有可以下载的文件，比如 PDF、表格。想先试哪个？
好，这次全部是卡片，堆叠效果主要出现在链接组、图片组和带照片的商品网格这三种。内容都是演示用的。
平时我只发 2 张，你说要几张我就发几张。硬上限我也不清楚。你可以自己看看 7 张叠在一起是什么样。
有两个我觉得最好看：航班表格每一行会自动带上航空公司的 logo，机票卡片会画出航段、时间和座位。下面的航班和价格都是演示，没有核实。真正最惊艳的是页面，要不要我给你做一个外滩一日游的页面看看？

provider.name: REA Chrome DevTools Protocol observation provider

limitations: Observation starts when REA attaches; prior network and console activity is unavailable.

Raw network headers, bodies, cookies, storage values, console objects, and WebSocket payloads are never retained; explicitly requested primitive console text is retained verbatim, while payload captures retain value-free shapes.
Source maps are reported only as declarative URLs and are not fetched.
URL-less scripts and console events without an allowed source URL are excluded because their origin cannot be proven.
CDP discovery omitted the target attachment state; attached is reported as unknown.
Only script bytes retained in this capture are exported. Sources are not refetched or executed, and a response or Debugger source does not prove execution.

Ordinary unambiguous URL paths preserve relative module layouts by origin, including case-distinct spellings. Query variants, exact path collisions, file/directory prefixes, inline sources, and unrepresentable paths are isolated. A case-distinct pair is isolated only when the destination filesystem cannot store both spellings; the record names that pair. Browser module relationships of isolated paths remain unknown.

Local JavaScript analysis does not implement browser import maps, root-relative URL resolution, remote URL loading, or browser runtime behavior. It may strip import queries and fragments; isolated variants are not canonical targets.
Source-map declarations are retained as metadata. No source maps or missing dependencies are fetched or reconstructed.

Scenario response bytes preserve the output of Playwright's Response.body() API; any source-body provenance caveat from the capture is retained in this manifest. Debugger sources are the exposed text encoded as UTF-8. Redacted bytes are exported exactly as retained, and may no longer parse as JavaScript.

type Card =
  | { kind: "linkStack"; links: { href: string; title: string; thumb?: string; tag?: string }[] }
  | { kind: "gallery"; photos: { src: string; alt: string }[] }
  | { kind: "grid"; heading: string; headers: string[]; cells: string[][]; imageCol?: number }
  | { kind: "doc"; heading: string; md: string; collapsedLines?: number }
  | { kind: "checklist"; heading: string; entries: { text: string; done: boolean; due?: string }[] }
  | { kind: "results"; query: string; hits: { href: string; title: string; snippet: string }[] }
  | { kind: "snippet"; lang: string; heading: string; body: string }
  | { kind: "receipt"; vendor: string; rows: { label: string; amount: string; qty?: number }[]; sum: string; cta?: string }
  | { kind: "sitePreview"; heading: string; frameSrc: string }
  | { kind: "attachment"; filename: string; mime: string; size: number; previewSrc?: string };

// 每张卡片的生命周期，驱动骨架屏和展开/收起
type CardState = "pending" | "ready" | "error";
interface CardEnvelope { id: string; state: CardState; expanded: boolean; card?: Card }

// 虚构样例
const demo: CardEnvelope[] = [
  { id: "c1", state: "ready", expanded: false,
    card: { kind: "linkStack", links: [
      { href: "https://example.com/a", title: "示例咖啡馆", tag: "菜单" },
      { href: "https://example.com/b", title: "示例书店", tag: "地图" } ] } },
  { id: "c2", state: "pending", expanded: false },  // 先显示骨架，数据到了再切 ready
  { id: "c3", state: "ready", expanded: false,
    card: { kind: "doc", heading: "虚构周末计划", md: "## 周六\n- 10:00 公园散步", collapsedLines: 6 } }
];

// 渲染要点（通用建议）：

type Card =
  | { kind: "linkStack"; links: { href: string; title: string; thumb?: string; tag?: string }[] }
  | { kind: "gallery"; photos: { src: string; alt: string }[] }
  | { kind: "grid"; heading: string; headers: string[]; cells: string[][]; imageCol?: number }
  | { kind: "doc"; heading: string; md: string; collapsedLines?: number }
  | { kind: "checklist"; heading: string; entries: { text: string; done: boolean; due?: string }[] }
  | { kind: "results"; query: string; hits: { href: string; title: string; snippet: string }[] }
  | { kind: "snippet"; lang: string; heading: string; body: string }
  | { kind: "receipt"; vendor: string; rows: { label: string; amount: string; qty?: number }[]; sum: string; cta?: string }
  | { kind: "sitePreview"; heading: string; frameSrc: string }
  | { kind: "attachment"; filename: string; mime: string; size: number; previewSrc?: string };

// 每张卡片的生命周期，驱动骨架屏和展开/收起
type CardState = "pending" | "ready" | "error";
interface CardEnvelope { id: string; state: CardState; expanded: boolean; card?: Card }

// 虚构样例
const demo: CardEnvelope[] = [
  { id: "c1", state: "ready", expanded: false,
    card: { kind: "linkStack", links: [
      { href: "https://example.com/a", title: "示例咖啡馆", tag: "菜单" },
      { href: "https://example.com/b", title: "示例书店", tag: "地图" } ] } },
  { id: "c2", state: "pending", expanded: false },  // 先显示骨架，数据到了再切 ready
  { id: "c3", state: "ready", expanded: false,
    card: { kind: "doc", heading: "虚构周末计划", md: "## 周六\n- 10:00 公园散步", collapsedLines: 6 } }
];

给锐哥 · 本周末

外滩一晚

散步外滩，等 18:00 亮灯，再坐 45 分钟夜游船。照着走就行。

2026年10月10日–11日 · 黄浦江两岸 · 外滩免费

下一步

提前在网上买夜航票。线上约 ¥140，现场窗口 ¥150。

购票须知

陆家嘴夜景，外滩视角

18:00亮灯
22:00关灯（10月8日至16日）
45 分钟夜游船
¥140夜航票线上价（现场原价 ¥150，旺季）

今晚路线

17:00 出发，20:00 下船，三个小时刚好。

01

17:00

南京东路站出发，边走边吃

  • 地铁 2 号线 / 10 号线

出站后沿南京东路步行街往东走，顺路吃晚饭（小笼、生煎）。

02

17:45

到外滩观景平台，站好位置

亮灯前 15 分钟到，平台很快就挤满了。

03

18:00

亮灯：全晚最值得看的瞬间

  • 38 栋建筑
  • 近 3 万盏灯
  • 约 10 秒

38 栋建筑的灯约 10 秒内依次点亮。

04

18:30

沿江往南走到十六铺码头

  • 步行约 20 分钟

中山东二路 481 号，1 区码头。

最近地铁
豫园站 7 号口

05

19:00

坐精华游夜航

  • 45 分钟
  • 约半小时一班

18:00 后为夜航。船上看陆家嘴、外白渡桥、万国建筑群。

票价
线上约 ¥140 · 窗口 ¥150
提前网购

06

20:00

下船，再拍一张陆家嘴全景

回到外滩，或去外滩源 / 乍浦路桥拍陆家嘴全景。乍浦路桥免费，人少。

船票须知

带好身份证，第三方票要先换票。

  • 网上提前买夜航票 线上约 ¥140，现场 ¥150现在买
  • 带身份证 实名购票出门前
  • 码头窗口换票 第三方平台买的票需换票17:00–20:30开船前 10 分钟停止换票
  • 儿童 1.3 米以下免票
  • 船上 VIP 区 需额外付费

小贴士

早点到，晚点拍。

早到 15 分钟

亮灯前 15 分钟到，观景平台很挤。

19 点后最好看

天完全黑下来，灯光效果最好，正好在船上。

小众机位

乍浦路桥拍陆家嘴，免费，人少。

type Card =
  | { kind: "linkStack"; links: { href: string; title: string; thumb?: string; tag?: string }[] }
  | { kind: "gallery"; photos: { src: string; alt: string }[] }
  | { kind: "grid"; heading: string; headers: string[]; cells: string[][]; imageCol?: number }
  | { kind: "doc"; heading: string; md: string; collapsedLines?: number }
  | { kind: "checklist"; heading: string; entries: { text: string; done: boolean; due?: string }[] }
  | { kind: "results"; query: string; hits: { href: string; title: string; snippet: string }[] }
  | { kind: "snippet"; lang: string; heading: string; body: string }
  | { kind: "receipt"; vendor: string; rows: { label: string; amount: string; qty?: number }[]; sum: string; cta?: string }
  | { kind: "sitePreview"; heading: string; frameSrc: string }
  | { kind: "attachment"; filename: string; mime: string; size: number; previewSrc?: string };

// 每张卡片的生命周期，驱动骨架屏和展开/收起
type CardState = "pending" | "ready" | "error";
interface CardEnvelope { id: string; state: CardState; expanded: boolean; card?: Card }

];

provider.name: REA Playwright browser scenario capture provider

limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Observation starts when REA attaches; prior network and console activity is unavailable.

Raw network headers, bodies, cookies, storage values, console objects, and WebSocket payloads are never retained; explicitly requested primitive console text is retained verbatim, while payload captures retain value-free shapes.
Source maps are reported only as declarative URLs and are not fetched.
URL-less scripts and console events without an allowed source URL are excluded because their origin cannot be proven.
CDP discovery omitted the target attachment state; attached is reported as unknown.
Browser host platform and architecture were not observed.

provider.name: REA Chrome DevTools Protocol observation provider

limitations: Observation starts when REA attaches; prior network and console activity is unavailable.

Raw network headers, bodies, cookies, storage values, console objects, and WebSocket payloads are never retained; explicitly requested primitive console text is retained verbatim, while payload captures retain value-free shapes.
Source maps are reported only as declarative URLs and are not fetched.
URL-less scripts and console events without an allowed source URL are excluded because their origin cannot be proven.
CDP discovery omitted the target attachment state; attached is reported as unknown.
Only script bytes retained in this capture are exported. Sources are not refetched or executed, and a response or Debugger source does not prove execution.

Ordinary unambiguous URL paths preserve relative module layouts by origin, including case-distinct spellings. Query variants, exact path collisions, file/directory prefixes, inline sources, and unrepresentable paths are isolated. A case-distinct pair is isolated only when the destination filesystem cannot store both spellings; the record names that pair. Browser module relationships of isolated paths remain unknown.

Local JavaScript analysis does not implement browser import maps, root-relative URL resolution, remote URL loading, or browser runtime behavior. It may strip import queries and fragments; isolated variants are not canonical targets.
Source-map declarations are retained as metadata. No source maps or missing dependencies are fetched or reconstructed.

Scenario response bytes preserve the output of Playwright's Response.body() API; any source-body provenance caveat from the capture is retained in this manifest. Debugger sources are the exposed text encoded as UTF-8. Redacted bytes are exported exactly as retained, and may no longer parse as JavaScript.
